comment:
I find it interesting that the document refers to the WHO Digital Adaptation Kits as an example of centralised metadata – but these are developed in silos and have no communal metadata repository or even standard definitions of common data elements (I work on these directly so am aware of several of their content and design). 
I would even suggest that WHO consider to engage the AIHW to build and maintain their DAK metadata in our metadata repository METEOR (it would need to be a funded project of course)
METEOR can be found at www.https://meteor.aihw.gov.au
